title: SvgStop
responsibility: Renders the native stop element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgStop.children
inputs.description: Optional Svelte snippet rendered as the content of the stop element only when truthy, invoked with no arguments as @render children(). When omitted, no snippet content is rendered inside the stop element.

outputs.name: SvgStop
outputs.description: The rendered SVG stop element: its tag is fixed to 'stop', every prop except children is spread onto it, and the children snippet is its only content. No wrapper element is added, and prop values are passed through without validation or defaults.
